SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
ORDER BY fiscal_period

-- Click-and-collect share of web net sales by fiscal period (periods 9 and 10 of FY2025/26)
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- Verify the periods 9 and 10 date ranges for FY2025/26
SELECT DISTINCT 
    fiscal_period,
    fiscal_period_label,
    MIN(calendar_date) as period_start,
    MAX(calendar_date) as period_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY fiscal_period

-- Sanity check: count of web orders by fulfilment type for periods 9 and 10
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       o.fulfilment_type,
       COUNT(*) as order_count,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as period_net_sales
FROM fact_web_order o
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year 
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
  AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type
